events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together nearly half a million people for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

angles.name: Ultimate Festival Memory
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off. What's your ultimate festival memory, or which acts would you have loved to see there?

events.title: Elvis Presley Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on this day in 1977 at the age of 42.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. His music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Enduring Rock
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid, Liam Gallagher, turns 54 today. Still got that undeniable swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond & Theme
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His message of peace and love lives on through his timeless music.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend John Cleese. What's your favourite Monty Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Death Anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, passed away on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?
